content: To put the supervised score into context we list scores that variants of Bert have achieved on other stance detection datasets in Table TABREF46. It seems that the supervised part of x-stance has a similar difficulty as the SemEval-2016 BIBREF0 or MPCHI BIBREF22 datasets on which Bert has previously been evaluated.
